rolling_origin_rule: For every target/horizon pair, training history stops at origin = target year - horizon.
2025_h1_note: The 2025 H1 forecast may use observed 2024 history because 2024 is known at the 2025 forecast origin. This is valid rolling-origin forecasting.
annual_selection_rule: Select one method across H1-H5 by reserved mean-horizon MAE; tie-break RMSE and absolute bias.
predictor_selection_rule: Select one method per predictor across H1-H5 by reserved mean-horizon NMAE_SD; tie-break NRMSE_SD and absolute bias.
why_one_method_per_predictor: Only two reserved target years are available per horizon. A single method per predictor avoids overfitting a separate method to each horizon and produces a more coherent 2026-2030 predictor path.
mape_predictors: Not used because indices can be zero or negative.
post_step27_status: After Step 27, 2024-2025 are validation evidence and are no longer held out. Step 28 may use all actual observations through 2025 for operational forecasting.
step22b_policy: Production LightGBM remains frozen and is not re-tested/retrained here.
future_forecast_policy: No 2026-2030 operational forecast is generated until Step 28.
